expectations.text: Explains the rule extends Entity List/MEU List license requirements to entities 50 percent or more owned, directly or indirectly, individually or in aggregate, by listed parties (OFAC-style ownership standard)
expectations.evidence: "extends Entity List and Military End User (MEU) List restrictions to entities that are owned 50% or more, directly or indirectly, individually or in the aggregate, by one or more listed parties"; compares to OFAC's 50% Rule.

expectations.text: Cites the origin rule: BIS interim final rule published September 30, 2025 (90 FR 47201)
expectations.evidence: Says only "interim final rule dated September 29, 2025"; never gives the 90 FR 47201 citation or the September 30, 2025 publication date.

expectations.text: States the rule is NOT currently in effect: stayed since November 10, 2025 (90 FR 50857)
expectations.evidence: Hedges: "the suspension runs through about November 9, 2026, so it is expiring right around now... I cannot confirm... Treat the current status as uncertain until verified." Does not state the rule is currently stayed and cites no 90 FR 50857.

expectations.text: States the stay was extended to January 10, 2027 by a BIS rule effective November 9, 2026 (FR Doc 2026-22793), so it does not snap back on November 10, 2026
expectations.evidence: No mention of the extension, January 10, 2027, or FR Doc 2026-22793; says only "It is possible BIS has already extended the stay... I cannot confirm that."

expectations.text: Advises completing ownership screening of counterparties tied to listed entities before January 10, 2027
expectations.evidence: Advises ownership-aware re-screening before year-end / "the day it takes effect", but never identifies January 10, 2027 as the deadline.
